text: Hải Phòng earmarks 466 hectares of industrial land for priority businesses

HẢI PHÒNG - The northern port city of Hải Phòng has earmarked 465.89 hectares of industrial land for high-tech firms, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and innovative start-ups across 32 industrial parks, the city's Economic Zones Management Board said on Tuesday.
The land allocation is intended to help priority business groups secure production sites and expand operations in the city.

A review completed on October 27 found that 16 industrial parks established or developed after the National Assembly adopted Resolution 198/2025/QH15 on May 17, 2025, accounted for 262.28 hectares of the designated land.

The largest allocation among these parks was 46.95 hectares at Trấn Dương-Hòa Bình Industrial Park, followed by 24.38 hectares at Bình Giang 2, 23.69 hectares at Thanh Hà and 20.89 hectares at Cộng Hòa 2.

The public disclosure of the land bank is part of Hải Phòng's efforts to translate policy commitments into practical support for businesses, particularly SMEs, high-tech enterprises and innovative startups, local authorities said.

The initiative is also aimed at implementing the Politburo's Resolution 68-NQ/TW and the National Assembly's Resolution 198/2025/QH15, which seek to mobilise resources and promote private-sector development.

Hải Phòng attracted more than $3.8 billion in foreign investment in the first 10 months of 2026, up 70 per cent from a year earlier and equivalent to 97 per cent of its annual target, according to city statistics.
Investment into industrial and economic zones exceeded $3.45 billion, reaching 95 per cent of the planned target.

The city expects the expansion of industrial infrastructure and the disclosure of land available to priority business groups to create more opportunities for local firms to join industrial supply chains. - VNS
